spec: 10 §9.4 (C1–C4), 10 §3.3 R5/R6/R9, 12 §7.5 (funding), 12 §9.4 (obligations table, final quantity), 12 §9.5, 12 §9.6 (PnL identity), 11 §4 (ts-compat reservation fee), 60 INV-1/2/3/7
notes: All money in USDC with 6 dp (micros). `derivation` shows how each expected value follows from the cited formula; a vector whose derivation is wrong is a test bug, to be fixed under 60 §10.3 (b).

ts-compat BUY reservation (10 R9, 11 §4, capital.ts:16-28): HalfAwayFromZero(limit x size) + fee_at_limit, where fee_at_limit = computePolymarketTakerFee(limit, size, 700 bps) = round4(0.07 x p x (1-p) x size) with < 0.0001 -> 0; fee 0 when post-only. Note: `700 bps` is the RATE of the p(1-p) curve, not 7% of notional.
realistic share-sized BUY reservation (10 C1): Ceil(limit x q) + fee at the limit price (the rules' fee for q shares at the limit, dp 5); post-only resting orders reserve notional only.
realistic collateral-sized BUY reservation (10 C1): amount + max fee over fill prices in [tick, limit]; for the exponent-1 curve = amount x rate x (1 - tick).
Fee era for the realistic examples: F3 (Symmetric 0.07, exp 1, dp 5) with tick 0.01, i.e. the RNG-7 fixture market btc-updown-15m-1780272000.
